title: The Iberian blackout
summary: Electricity supply failed across mainland Portugal and Spain around midday on 28 April 2025 and took most of a day to restore. The event is placed at Lisbon for want of a point that would stand for a whole peninsula, and no edge leaves it: what caused it was still being examined by the system operators and the regulators, and this atlas will not guess.
